decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered the product feed for actual backpacks, excluding items like hand warmers, towels, and food. Within the backpack category, the ZOMAKE 20L (prod_backpacks_173) and MOSISO Sling (prod_backpacks_051) stood out for their massive volume of reviews and high ratings. I also considered specialized options like the KAUKKO laptop bag (prod_backpacks_184), the SEEHONOR cooler backpack (prod_backpacks_002), and the Piscifun dry bag (prod_backpacks_199). I ultimately chose the ZOMAKE 20L because it is a 'Best Seller' with nearly 15,000 reviews and a high 4.6-star rating, providing incredible value as a packable daypack for only $13.99.
